name: Zurich
dek: Fluntern, the city station. Kloten is the airport file and is not this table.
paragraphs: Zürich/Fluntern is WMO 06660, height 556 m, position 47°22′41″N, 8°33′57″E. The country sheet uses the same station. Kloten is 426 m and is a different file. The missing number-of-years row is in this file too. The values are still the ones the submission prints.

Average lows go below zero in winter in this table. That is Fluntern's figure. The time-zone comment Büsingen belongs to the German exception on the shared Europe/Zurich row, and the IANA header says the comment is not for Switzerland.

climate.caption: Station: Zürich/Fluntern, WMO 06660. The file spells it ZUERICH / FLUNTERN. Not Kloten.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed. This Swiss file has mean and sum rows for every month and does not include a number-of-years row, so the sheet cannot confirm 30 years from the file itself. The file is the 1991–2020 submission. Zürich/Kloten (WMO 06670, height 426 m) is the airport file and was not averaged with Fluntern.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and J, 230 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Switzerland at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page on 15 November 2026 did not return the list. The archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Article 8(1) of the Verkehrsregelnverordnung says that on roads with several lanes in the same direction, the outermost lane on the right is the one to use. That does not apply when overtaking, when moving into position, when driving in parallel columns, or inside a built-up area. Article 7 is headed Rechtsfahren. It says traffic islands, barred areas, and obstacles in the middle of the carriageway are passed on the right, with an exception for a driver turning left at an island in the middle of a junction. The article cites Article 34(1) of the Road Traffic Act as its parent. The text of that parent article was not opened on this pass, so it is not quoted.

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.value: Not obligatory; about 10% or round up
tipping.detail: Switzerland Tourism's tipping page says the guest is not obliged to tip, and that in many restaurants it is customary to pay a tip of approximately 10 percent, or to round up to a round amount. The same office's food-and-drink page says you never have to worry about tipping because tips are included in the price, and that rounding up to the nearest franc is a way to acknowledge good service. Those two pages are not averaged. This sheet uses the tipping page.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Switzerland, last reviewed 25 August 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Swiss Franc and the code CHF for Switzerland. The same country block also lists WIR Euro (CHE) and WIR Franc (CHW). This sheet names the franc.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab gives Switzerland one row, Europe/Zurich. zone1970.tab puts Switzerland on the same row as Germany and Liechtenstein, named Europe/Zurich, with the comment Büsingen. The file's header says that comment is useful only for Germany, because Switzerland and Liechtenstein have no other zone. The comment is not printed as a description of Zurich.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.note: The migration secretariat's page on entering Switzerland. We do not restate a visa rule.
